title_en: Close to Ballet School, 2+1 apartment for sale, with perfect layout and location!!
description_en: Near the Ballet School, 2+1 Apartment for Sale, with Perfect Location and Layout!!! The apartment is located on the fourth floor of an existing building. The apartment has a total area of ​​100 m2. The organization of the apartment begins with the corridor that divides the living room together with the cooking and dining area and exit to the balcony, two bedrooms, a bathroom with window and a balcony. The apartment is completely invested from scratch, starting with new electrical and plumbing installations, parquet, plastic double-glazed windows, etc... The area offers many facilities, starting from the perfect location, the proximity to the Center and the institutions, and for this reason it is a very good opportunity both for living and for investment, since the rents are very high in that area. It has full mortgage documentation.
